name: zsnd_fade_dispatch_list_push_back
description: zSndFadeDispatchList::PushBack appends a completed fade entry to the dispatch fade-list tail.
known_limits: VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob0_facs COFF byte comparison passed with zero unmasked mismatches after relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a3a80 allocates a 12-byte zSndFadeListNode, links it after the dispatch sentinel's previous node, stores the zSndFadeEntry payload, and increments g_zSndFadeDispatchListCount.

The native fade-entry smoke completes DirectSound and A3D fades through zSndFadeEntry::TickAndMaybeDispatch, verifies the dispatch list count increments, and checks the appended tail node carries the completed fade payload.
